# Anthony Pye

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [George](../character/george.md) (relative)

## Appearance

Anthony Pye is a young boy with a dark, sullen little face. He possesses black eyes that often convey hostile, curious, or mocking expressions.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P23](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0023)_

## Personality

Anthony Pye is characterized by an impertinent swagger and a disruptive manner in the classroom. He holds a clear prejudice against female educators, openly asserting that girl teachers are inherently ineffective.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P26](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0026), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P1](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0001)_

## Traits

- dislikes female teachers  <sub>[v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P26](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0026)</sub>
- impertinent  <sub>[v2 XII A Jonah Day P1](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0001)</sub>

## History

Anthony Pye is an orphan who was taken in by his aunt, Mrs. George [Pye](../codex/factions.md#pyes). He began attending school under [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), where he initially acted sullenly toward her. After Anthony placed a mouse in Anne's desk, a distraught [Anne](../character/anne.md) lost her temper and whipped him.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P2](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0002), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P13](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0013), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P14](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0014), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P15](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0015), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P16](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0016), +105 more_

## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--anthony-pye.md)

Anthony is a student in Anne's classroom, where he initially behaves sullenly toward her. Their dynamic reaches a turning point when Anthony places a mouse in her desk while she is suffering from a toothache, prompting a furious [Anne](../character/anne.md) to whip him. To her surprise, this punishment earns her Anthony's newfound respect, improving his demeanor toward her.

- Student of — school pupil  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033), +1 more</sub>
